technical.summary: Mixed bullish technicals with overbought oscillators and weak momentum confirmation; SMA golden cross and long-term trend support moderate entry but lack of MACD/EMA confirmation and below-cloud Ichimoku signal caution.

fundamental.summary: ABT shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 70 days adds timing risk.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (299.36) with imminent CPI event (1 day) creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 70 days adds secondary risk layer.
